statement: Pinned xone uses the first free of sixteen allocated wireless-client entries, skips duplicate association for an active client and frees the entry on disassociation. Entry numbers can be reused, but no persistent per-client input instance or guaranteed identity-to-entry assignment is maintained across detach. The sixteen-entry software allocation is not a physically verified simultaneous client limit.

applicability.revision: Out-of-tree xone f2aa9fe01103d7600553b505b298ff0bd47ff280; Linux v7.3 or pinned SDL where cited
